title: Pengalihan subsidi BBM September 2022: harga Pertalite dan Solar, BLT BBM, BSU, dan 2% Dana Transfer Umum
status_note: Prices, budget figures and the compensation package come from official releases (ESDM, Setkab, DJPb/Kemenkeu). Inflation context comes from BPS (90 CPI cities). The Kemenkeu article of 19 Sep 2022 could not be read: the host timed out and WebFetch returned an empty shell. The official DJPb (Kemenkeu) KPPN Parepare article of 14 Sep 2022 is used instead. The year-end subsidy outturn (Rp551.2 trillion) comes from news reporting of the Finance Minister's APBN KiTa briefing and is not used in game text. Not 'validated': no regional fuel consumption, pass-through, beneficiary or transfer data.
geographic_resolution: National policy. Inflation is observed in 90 CPI cities (BPS), which are not representative of every kab/kota. No regional fuel-consumption or beneficiary data was retrieved.

real_facts.fact: From 3 September 2022, 14:30 WIB, Pertalite rose from Rp7,650 to Rp10,000 per litre and subsidized Solar from Rp5,150 to Rp6,800. Non-subsidized Pertamax rose from Rp12,500 to Rp14,500.

The 2022 fuel subsidy and compensation budget had risen from Rp152.5 trillion to Rp502.4 trillion and could keep rising. The President stated that more than 70% of subsidies were enjoyed by better-off groups, namely private car owners.
real_facts.quote: Lebih dari 70% subsidi justru dinikmati oleh kelompok masyarakat yang mampu yaitu pemilik mobil-mobil pribadi.
real_facts.note: The budget figures are government budget estimates. The 70% share is a government claim; its underlying distributional data was not retrieved.

real_facts.fact: Compensation announced: BLT BBM of Rp12.4 trillion at Rp150,000 per month for four months for 20.65 million families; BSU of Rp9.6 trillion at Rp600,000 for 16 million workers earning at most Rp3.5 million per month; and regional governments to use 2% of the Dana Transfer Umum (Rp2.17 trillion) for public transport, online ojek and fishers.

DJPb (Kemenkeu) KPPN Parepare: Rp24.17 trillion of subsidy and compensation redirected to social protection. BLT BBM targets the poorest and most vulnerable 30% (20.65 million KPM), paid in two installments. Kemensos requested Rp12.39 trillion for the aid plus Rp572 billion for distribution via PT Pos. The 2% DTU is earmarked for social assistance, job creation and transport-sector support (public transport, ojek, fishers, UMKM).

BPS: September 2022 inflation was 1.17% month-on-month, 5.95% year-on-year and 4.84% year-to-date. 88 of 90 CPI cities recorded inflation (highest Bukittinggi 1.87%, lowest Merauke 0.07%), and 2 recorded deflation (Manokwari 0.64%, Timika 0.59%). The transport group rose 8.88%, the largest of any group. Core inflation was 0.30% month-on-month.
real_facts.note: Context only. It does not prove that the fuel adjustment alone caused the observed inflation, and the 90 CPI cities are not extrapolated to the 514 kab/kota.

real_facts.fact: The Finance Minister reported year-end 2022 realization of energy subsidy and compensation of Rp551.2 trillion (compensation Rp379.3 trillion, subsidy Rp171.9 trillion).
real_facts.note: News report of an official briefing, published after the decision date. Research context only; not shown in game.

trigger: Rising world oil prices pushing the 2022 subsidy and compensation budget far above its original allocation
root_causes_note: The government attributes the budget increase to oil prices and consumption. The game does not model world oil prices; the pressure is represented by the case's design parameters.
stakeholders: rumah tangga miskin dan rentan (penerima BLT)
interaction_with_other_cases: CASE-0003 (cooking oil) also acts through the national price_pressure driver. Explicit rule (D-074): contributions are additive, clamped to [0,1] at use, and decay together. SimLedger drivers attribute every region's price change to each source separately. Conditions on price_pressure (e.g. CASE-0003-C) read the combined value. That is documented and inspectable in the PEMICU block.

game_adaptation_notes: National case. Fiscal consequences use the national fiscal_space index. The fuel price adjustment uses the national price_pressure driver, attributed by source (D-074). Household support uses welfare in all 514 regions, scaled toward regions with lower simulated welfare as a proxy for targeting the poorest 30%. That proxy is UNCALIBRATED: real DTKS eligibility is not modeled. Transport and livelihood support uses welfare only (temporary, uniform), because no regional data exists for ojek, fishers or public transport. All magnitudes are design values derived only loosely from the documented ratios: the full package is about Rp24 trillion against a budget increase of about Rp350 trillion, and the full adjustment raises Pertalite by about 31%. No new variable.
fact_vs_simulation_notes: Prices, budget estimates, the compensation package and the September 2022 inflation figures are real. The President's options and every consequence are SIMULATED. The game does not claim that its simulated inflation or welfare paths happened.
